units.source_text: 龙助家是室町一带的大批发商，伙伴中也有各种各样财雄势大的人。

en.t: Ryosuke's family ran a large wholesale business in the Muromachi area, and among their associates were all sorts of wealthy and influential people.

units.source_text: 龙助虽正在大学研究院念书，但是店铺的重担自然而然要落在他肩上。

en.t: Although Ryosuke was studying in graduate school, the heavy responsibility of the shop naturally fell on his shoulders.
